ar.title: الفاصوليا باللحم

steps.n1: يضرب البصل والطماطم والفلفل الرومي والثوم والملح والفلفل في الخلاط.
steps.n2: يوضع اللحم في إناء به زيت ويشوح فقط، ثم يصب عليه خليط البصل والطماطم المضروب حتى تنضج الطماطم.
steps.n3: نضيف مقدار من الماء يكفي لكمية الفاصوليا ونتركه يغلي، ونضيف له الملح والفلفل.
steps.n4: بعد الغليان نضيف الفاصوليا ونخفض درجة الحرارة حتى ينضج الخضار واللحم.

en.title: Beans with Meat

steps.n1: Blend the onion, tomatoes, bell pepper, garlic, salt, and pepper in a blender.
steps.n2: Place the meat in a pot with oil and sear it, then pour the blended onion and tomato mixture over it until the tomatoes are cooked through.
steps.n3: Add enough water to cover the amount of green beans and bring to a boil, adding salt and pepper.
steps.n4: Once boiling, add the green beans and lower the heat until the vegetables and meat are fully cooked.

legacySteps: Blend the onion, tomatoes, bell pepper, garlic, salt, and pepper in a blender.
Place the meat in a pot with oil and sear it, then pour the blended onion and tomato mixture over it until the tomatoes are cooked through.
Add enough water to cover the amount of green beans and bring to a boil, adding salt and pepper.
Once boiling, add the green beans and lower the heat until the vegetables and meat are fully cooked.
